title: Necro-Fantasia 亡灵契约师重置
description:
Necro-Fantasia 亡灵契约师重置

围绕灾厄、自身灾厄与奥斯提，对《杀戮尖塔 2》的亡灵契约师进行部分重做。

主要改动：
- 原版卡牌给予的灾厄提高至原始数值的1.5倍，施加者额外获得原始数值三分之一的灾厄，均向下取整。

- 重做灾厄之衣、负能量脉冲、荒疫打击、吞噬生命、灵魂风暴；死神形态额外使你不会因灾厄死亡。
- 新增十三张卡牌：死生契阔、负能量吸收、共赴黄泉、此恨绵绵、血誓、黑暗仪式、饮鸩、借尸还魂、灵魂虚影、同仇敌忾、伙伴、虚空引渡、负能量灌注。
- 包含中文与英文本地化及新增美术。

需要 STS2 RitsuLib 0.6.15 或更新版本。包含游戏0.111与0.113的独立兼容实现。 - 增加虚无, 灵魂, 奥斯提, 灾厄等不同体系之间联动 

部分新增美术使用 AI 生成素材。

Necro-Fantasia

A partial rework of the Necrobinder for Slay the Spire 2, focused on Doom, self-inflicted Doom, and Osty.

Main changes:
- Vanilla cards apply 150% of their original Doom. The applier also receives Doom equal to one third of the original amount. Both values are rounded down.
- Reworks Shroud, Negative Pulse, Blight Strike, Devour Life, and Soul Storm. Reaper Form also prevents you from dying to Doom.
- Adds thirteen cards: Death and Life's Pact, Negative Energy Absorption, Together Unto Death, Endless Hatred, Blood Oath, Dark Ritual, Poisoned Draught, Borrowed Body, Soul Phantom, Shared Vengeance, Partner, Void Passage, and Negative Energy Infusion.
- Includes Chinese and English localization and new artwork.
- Introduces new synergies between Ethereal, Souls, Osty, and Doom.

Requires STS2 RitsuLib 0.6.15 or later. Includes separate implementations for game versions 0.111 and 0.113.

Some new artwork uses AI-generated assets.

同时支持0.111.x,0.113.x
changeNote:
0.1.5
- 吞噬生命重做：保留1费稀有能力定位。每回合开始时，所有敌人失去1点生命，每有一名敌人生成一张灵魂加入弃牌堆；升级后随机加入抽牌堆。不再通过打出灵魂触发召唤。
- 灵魂风暴重做：保留1费稀有攻击定位，造成6点基础伤害。消耗牌堆中每有一张灵魂，生成一张灵魂加入弃牌堆；升级后随机加入抽牌堆。不再随消耗的灵魂数量增加伤害，原有消耗牌不被移走。
- 同步中英文本地化与说明，沿用原版美术。

Devour Life: Remains a 1-Energy Rare Power. At the start of your turn, ALL enemies lose 1 HP. Generate one Soul per enemy in the discard pile, or at random positions in the draw pile when upgraded. Playing Souls no longer triggers Summon through this Power.
Soul Storm: Remains a 1-Energy Rare Attack, now dealing 6 base damage. Generate one new Soul per Soul in the Exhaust Pile in the discard pile, or at random positions in the draw pile when upgraded. Damage no longer scales with exhausted Souls; existing exhausted cards are not moved.
Updated Chinese and English text and documentation; retains vanilla artwork.

两套兼容实现编译通过，256项自动测试通过；不替代游戏内和多人实测。
Both compatibility builds and 256 automated tests pass; in-game and multiplayer playtests remain outstanding.

同时支持0.111.x,0.113.x
